title: M jak mio

ai_content.desc_en: M jak miłość, known as "L for Love" in English, is a Polish soap opera that follows the multi-generational story of the Mostowiak family. Premiering in 2000, the series has become a staple on TVP2, shifting to a new timeslot and airing twice weekly after its first season. It has since been the most-watched drama on Polish television, leading to a Russian adaptation titled "Lyubov kak Lyubov." The show is also available internationally on TVP Polonia with English subtitles.
